text: The engine now sends a build id (its start time plus a hash of the served `index.html`) on the SSE `hello` frame and a `build` event when `packages/ui/dist` changes, and `useStream.ts` reloads the page when that id changes. A new `bun run dev` in `code/package.json` runs `bun --watch` on the engine and `vite build --watch` on the UI in parallel, and both paths reloaded the page in a test on port 9662. Committed as `65a7fea` with `API.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` updated; the engine on 9656 needs one manual restart before auto reload applies to it.
